item.title: Matthew Greiner Wraps Up Olympic Debut In Luge Men’s Singles
item.description: Park City native Matthew Greiner wrapped up his first-ever Olympics with the Luge Men's Singles' third and fourth runs on Sunday.

item.title: Ilia Malinin’s stunning free skate secures US figure skating team gold at Milan Cortina Olympics
item.description: It seemed only fitting that Ilia Malinin was the first one to get his Olympic gold medal after the U.S. successfully defended its team title by holding off the Japanese on Sunday night in the three-day competition at the Milan Cortina Games.

item.title: New Zealand mosque shooter seeks to discard his guilty pleas, saying prison made him irrational
item.description: The man who killed 51 Muslim worshipers at two mosques in New Zealand’s deadliest mass shooting told an appeals court Monday that he felt forced to admit to the crimes because of “irrationality” due to harsh prison conditions, as he sought to have his guilty pleas discarded.

item.title: Review: Bad Bunny brought Puerto Rico’s history and culture to a revolutionary Super Bowl show
item.description: The sun hung low when Bad Bunny emerged in Puerto Rico's sugar cane fields during his half time show, surrounded by jibaros in pavas (rural farmers in traditional straw hats), viejitos playing dominos (an affectionate term for older men) and a piragua stand (shaved ice) — undeniable symbols of Puerto Rico.

item.title: Utah 2034 hosts welcome event for families of Team USA athletes in Milan
item.description: The Utah 2034 Olympic and Paralympic Committee hosted a welcome gathering on Sunday for families of American athletes competing in Milan.

item.title: Seahawks ride their ‘Dark Side’ defense to a Super Bowl title, pounding the Patriots 29-13
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks have won the franchise's second Super Bowl, and defense was the driving force behind this championship.

item.title: Two Locals Win Super Bowl Ring With Seattle Seahawks
item.description: Two NFL players with ties to the state of Utah completed the ultimate goal on Sunday, winning a Super Bowl with the Seattle Seahawks.

item.title: Seahawks Ride Their Defense To Super Bowl Title, Pounding Patriots 29-13
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks, led by their top-ranked defense, beat the New England Patriots on Sunday to win the franchise’s second Super Bowl.

item.title: Downtown Super Bowl LX watch party crowd calls the halftime show the highlight of the game
item.description: Football fans filled downtown bars and restaurants Sunday night as crowds gathered in team colors to watch Super Bowl LX.

item.title: A ‘dream job’ for a Utah artist behind a third of the pro football hall of fame busts
item.description: SALT LAKE CITY – A Utah artist and former BYU Football player is marking a major milestone in a dream career — sculpting the bronze busts of NFL legends for the Pro Football Hall of Fame.
